_meta.description: Berserker subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: lifesteal, raw damage, bruiser survivability.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente le vol de vie de 1% et l'ATK de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases lifesteal by 1% and ATK by 0.3% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'ATK de 1% et la chance de critique de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases ATK by 1% and crit chance by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la reduction de degats de 0.8% et les PV max de 0.8% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage reduction by 0.8% and max HP by 0.8% per level.
